# ROS 2 MCP Server — Full Specification & Architectural Integration Guide

> Universal Physical AI Coprocessor and Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway connecting 1,000+ AI models to ROS 2 robots with 3-tier execution sandboxing, fast-forward kinematic trajectory prediction, and 2D spatial LiDAR ASCII radar.

## Architectural Overview & Transport Layer
The server implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification (version 2024-11-05) over standard input/output (sys.stdin / sys.stdout) with zero external runtime dependencies.
- Transport: Line-delimited UTF-8 JSON-RPC 2.0.
- Diagnostics Logging: Directed to sys.stderr with prefix [ros2-mcp].
- Concurrency: Background rclpy MultiThreadedExecutor daemon thread with synchronous futures bridging to preserve non-blocking stdio processing.
- Simulation Mode: Deterministic MockInterface executes automatically when rclpy is absent, supplying synthetic 360-ray LiDAR pointclouds, 6-DOF IMU data, and multi-namespace swarm graphs.

## Complete 16-Tool Catalog & Parameter Signatures

### 1. ping
- Description: Test connectivity to the ROS 2 bridge and verify active node count.
- Input Schema: {}
- Output: {"status": "ok", "active_nodes": int, "timestamp": float}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

### 2. system_diagnostics
- Description: Complete health check reporting battery status, LiDAR range, IMU orientation, active nodes, and issue list.
- Input Schema: {}
- Output: {"status": str, "battery": dict, "lidar": dict, "imu": dict, "active_nodes": int, "critical_issues": list, "warnings": list}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

### 3. list_topics
- Description: Enumerate all active ROS 2 DDS topics and their registered message types.
- Input Schema: {}
- Output: {"topics": [{"name": str, "type": str}]}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

### 4. read_topic
- Description: Read latest message from a topic with age tracking.
- Input Schema:
  - topic (string, required): Topic name, e.g. "/scan"
  - msg_type (string, default: "std_msgs/String"): ROS 2 message type
  - timeout_ms (integer, default: 3000): Maximum wait time in milliseconds
  - latched (boolean, default: false): True for latched topics (/map, /robot_description)
- Output: {"status": "ok", "topic": str, "data": dict, "age_ms": float}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

### 5. publish_topic
- Description: Publish a message payload to a ROS 2 topic under sandbox enforcement.
- Input Schema:
  - topic (string, required): Destination topic name, e.g. "/cmd_vel"
  - msg_type (string, required): ROS 2 message type, e.g. "geometry_msgs/Twist"
  - payload (object, required): Message fields dictionary
- Output: {"status": "published", "topic": str, "bytes": int}
- Safety: Blocked in READ_ONLY; allowlisted in SAFE_WRITE (/cmd_vel, /target_velocity, /led_state, /speaker_cmd, /arm_target_angle); unrestricted in FULL.

### 6. get_robot_snapshot
- Description: Parallel fetch of LiDAR, IMU, battery, cmd_vel, and odometry in one call.
- Input Schema: {}
- Output: {"status": "ok", "timestamp": float, "snapshot": {"scan": dict, "imu": dict, "battery": dict, "odom": dict}}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

### 7. list_nodes
- Description: List all currently running ROS 2 nodes with namespace and full graph name.
- Input Schema: {}
- Output: {"nodes": [{"name": str, "namespace": str, "full_name": str}]}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

### 8. get_node_info
- Description: Inspect a node's publishers, subscribers, and services.
- Input Schema:
  - node_name (string, required): Target node name
- Output: {"node": str, "publishers": list, "subscribers": list, "services": list}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

### 9. get_parameter
- Description: Read dynamic parameter value from running node.
- Input Schema:
  - node_name (string, required): Target node name
  - param_name (string, required): Parameter key
- Output: {"node": str, "param": str, "value": any, "type": str}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

### 10. set_parameter
- Description: Dynamically set parameter on node under sandbox allowlist.
- Input Schema:
  - node_name (string, required): Target node name
  - param_name (string, required): Parameter key
  - value (any, required): New parameter value
- Output: {"status": "ok", "node": str, "param": str, "value": any}
- Safety: Blocked in READ_ONLY; allowlisted in SAFE_WRITE; unrestricted in FULL.

### 11. get_pid_state
- Description: Read Kp, Ki, Kd gains and safety bounds from controller node.
- Input Schema:
  - node_name (string, required): Target node name
  - kp_param (string, default: "kp"): Parameter key for proportional gain
  - ki_param (string, default: "ki"): Parameter key for integral gain
  - kd_param (string, default: "kd"): Parameter key for derivative gain
- Output: {"node": str, "gains": {"Kp": float, "Ki": float, "Kd": float}, "bounds": dict}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

### 12. tune_pid
- Description: Apply validated PID gains with physics bounds checking.
- Input Schema:
  - node_name (string, required): Target node name
  - kp (number, optional): Proportional gain (>= 0.0)
  - ki (number, optional): Integral gain (>= 0.0)
  - kd (number, optional): Derivative gain (>= 0.0)
  - kp_param, ki_param, kd_param (string, defaults: "kp", "ki", "kd")
- Output: {"status": "ok"|"validation_error", "applied": list, "guidance": str}
- Safety: Blocked in READ_ONLY; allowlisted in SAFE_WRITE; unrestricted in FULL.

### 13. predict_trajectory [World-First]
- Description: Simulates robot motion trajectory (x, y, theta) over time dt_sec in <0.1ms compute.
- Input Schema:
  - linear_x (number, required): Proposed forward linear velocity (m/s)
  - angular_z (number, required): Proposed angular velocity (rad/s)
  - dt_sec (number, default: 3.0): Prediction horizon duration
- Output: {"status": "success", "predicted_final_pose": {"x_m": float, "y_m": float, "heading_deg": float}, "safety_assessment": {"status": str, "risk_score": float}}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

### 14. predictive_safety_check [World-First]
- Description: Evaluates proposed commands against stability constraints, auto-correcting unsafe LLM inputs and returning mathematical proofs.
- Input Schema:
  - command_type (string, required): "tune_pid" or "publish_cmd_vel"
  - target (string, required): Node or topic identifier
  - proposed_value (any, required): Value or velocity payload
- Output: {"status": "success", "evaluated_safe_value": any, "auto_corrected": bool, "safety_reasoning": str, "control_theory_proof": str}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

### 15. get_spatial_map [World-First]
- Description: Converts 360-degree LiDAR pointclouds into a 2D ASCII radar grid directly inside MCP response JSON.
- Input Schema:
  - scan_topic (string, default: "/scan"): LaserScan topic
  - grid_size (integer, default: 13): Odd matrix dimension
  - max_range_m (number, default: 3.5): Radar visualizer cutoff
- Output: {"status": "success", "spatial_grid_ascii": str, "obstacle_summary": {"clearance_front_m": float, "clearance_left_m": float, "clearance_right_m": float}}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

### 16. swarm_fleet_status [World-First]
- Description: Scans multi-namespace ROS 2 graph and aggregates multi-robot fleet health in one call.
- Input Schema: {}
- Output: {"status": "success", "total_active_fleet_members": int, "fleet_overview": dict, "namespaces": list}
- Safety: READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, FULL

## Mathematical Formulations
1. O(1) Tool Dispatch:
   Hash lookup overhead: T_dispatch < 0.08ms.
   Load factor alpha = 16 / 64 = 0.25. E[T_lookup] <= 1.15 operations.

2. Token Bucket Rate Limiting:
   B(t) = min(B_max, B(t - delta_t) + r * delta_t).
   Context budget: len(JSON_str) <= 4 * T_budget.

3. 2D LiDAR Polar-to-Cartesian SE(3) Discretization:
   gx = c - round((r_i / r_max) * c * cos(theta_i))
   gy = c - round((r_i / r_max) * c * sin(theta_i))
   Grid occupancy: 'R' (Center), '*' (Obstacle), '.' (Clear space).

4. 3-Tier Security Gate Invariants:
   READ_ONLY: All writes blocked.
   SAFE_WRITE: Allowlisted topics (/cmd_vel, /target_velocity, /led_state, /speaker_cmd, /arm_target_angle) and allowlisted node parameters.
   FULL: Unrestricted (simulation only).
   Audit logging: Thread-safe mutex lock guarding all state modifications.
